title: Nova Cloud Platform
summary: Transformed a cluttered 2018 multi-cloud console into a high-performance spatial observability dashboard.
problem: Engineers were overwhelmed by 140+ nested menu items, 4.8s initial load times, and poor incident correlation during outages.
solution: Designed a unified node canvas with sub-second WebSocket telemetry, keyboard command palette, and dark spatial aesthetics.

title: Apex Global Banking
summary: Rebuilt a legacy institutional banking interface into an ultra-fast, dark luxury multi-currency treasury portal.
problem: Corporate treasurers struggled with disconnected FX rate sheets, manual reconciliation lags, and high error rates in bulk wires.
solution: Engineered a real-time reactive liquidity dashboard with instant wire verification, keyboard shortcuts, and biometrics.

title: Nordic Living Storefront
summary: Elevated a cookie-cutter Shopify template into an immersive, editorial Scandinavian architectural storefront.
problem: Generic square product grids destroyed brand equity and had high cart abandonment due to cluttered checkout steps.
solution: Implemented smooth GSAP shared-element transitions, tactile product configurators, and an invisible slide-out cart.

title: Pulse Health Portal
summary: Replaced a high-friction clinical hospital portal with a reassuring, accessibility-first telehealth platform.
problem: Elderly and anxious patients experienced high abandonment during consultation booking and lab report reviews.
solution: Redesigned the patient journey with conversational scheduling, large high-contrast typography, and 100% WCAG AAA conformance.
